thesis: ASO is a parabolic, unexplained run (+51% in 63 days, two large jumps on 11/4 and 11/9 with no identifiable catalyst) in a confirmed risk-off tape where QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX is at the 88th percentile and the 10-year yield is rising. Price is extended (about 10% above SMA20, RSI about 70) and the last bounce came on weak volume, so a mean-reversion leg toward the 50-day area is more likely than a clean pullback hold. Fiscal Q3 earnings on 12/8 fall inside the swing window with about 20% short interest, so gap risk is large and a miss could reverse the whole move. The 2.9 reward/risk assumes the stop at 66.5 fills, but a gap through it is plausible on macro or news shocks.
